thread:
nina: FYI enterprise prospect wants explicit separation between live access, archive search, and legal-hold lifecycles. they also want BYOK enforcement options at tenant level before SOC2 acceptance.

rahul: Can you list concrete asks? we need to map to launch gates.

nina: From their note: 1) tenant retention profiles with independent TTLs, 2) legal-hold flag that prevents deletion and index compaction for held items, 3) BYOK policy during onboarding: enforce|fallback|notify and a documented SLA for handshake.

maria: For product: add onboarding toggle "BYOK_enforcement" and surface fallback behavior in contract. Sales will need wording.

dev-bot: retention-template created for tenant Z-900 at 2025-11-03T14:21:05Z

jon: Security: BYOK enforcement can mean request failures. Recommend default pilot = fallback to provider key (with signed consent) so pilot customers remain functional.

rahul: Implementation sketch: retention API + console (PATCH tenant), legal-hold snapshot layer (prevent GC), BYOK handshake state machine + audit events. Example log event: {event:byok_handshake,tenant:T900,mode:enforce,outcome:fallback|success,duration_ms:1200}.

maria: Ops note: legal-hold requires replication to DR region otherwise customers will claim evidence gap. Limit pilot to single region or add replication step.

nina: Timeline ask: sales wants a pilot in 5-6 weeks. dev estimate: retention API + UI (1.5w), legal-hold snapshot mechanics (3w), byok handshake + logging (1.5w), tests + docs (1w) => parallel ~5 weeks.

jon: Action items: rahul to draft PRD with acceptance criteria + event schema, jon to own threat model, maria to draft pilot contract language and fallback consent. nina: coordinate pilot customers.

dev-bot: reminder: compliance sync tomorrow 09:00 add pilot checklist to agenda.
